source: ranked lineups in data/aggregates/team-comps/1.18/ (games of ten minutes or more)
note: bands[key] = one rank band (rank held in that game, that rank and above; unplaced players only under all): minGames = games a hero + Eternal group needs there, playerRows = player-games in the band. bands[key].boards[job].sections[] = one lane group of a job: average = the job's stat over every player in those lanes; rows = groups whose win rate, pulled 100 games toward 50%, is 50% or better, highest value first (value = the job's stat, see boards[].unit); one row per hero and lane, on its best qualifying Eternal, with its other qualifying Eternals in alts; others = the same hero and lane on every other Eternal; augment / crest / core / later = what the group's players run most (core = opening three in purchase order; later = items bought fourth to sixth, share of players who bought a fourth); eternals = each Eternal against the same hero on every other Eternal over the heroes good at the job: winDelta in points with its 95% margin, valuePct = change in the job's stat, verdict only when the margin clears zero.
